pages.text: A captured black hole, held at the base of a great ring. Charge it and the ring tears open into the $(thing)Event Horizon$(): the world inside a black hole.

pages.name: Horizon Ring
pages.text: 23 $(item)Horizon Frames$() standing in a circle, the $(item)Horizon Gate$() in the middle of the bottom. It can face either way. Keep the inside open.

pages.title: Charging
pages.text: Use blocks on the gate to feed it mass, like a bomb: $(num)1$() mass per block, and far more for $(l:event_horizon/materials)Neutronium$(). Hoppers and pipes work too.$(br2)Each player who goes through burns $(num)1,000$() mass.

pages.title: Opening
pages.text: Use the gate empty-handed, or give it a $(thing)redstone pulse$(). The frames light up one by one round the ring as it spins up, then it $(danger)bursts open$(): $(danger)don't stand right in front of it$(), the blast throws you back.$(br2)It stays open for $(num)30$() seconds. $(thing)Walk into it$() to go through.

pages.title: Arriving
pages.text: You land on a platform of Corrupted Stone high in the Event Horizon, straight "below" the ring you used (same x and z), facing a Horizon Ring of its own.$(br2)Every trip through the same ring lands on the same platform.

pages.title: Getting back
pages.text: Inside, Horizon Rings open for free. Open one and walk through to come out in front of the ring you went in by.$(br2)An $(item)Escape Recording$() does the same from anywhere inside: hold it for two seconds.$(br2)Beds and respawn anchors don't work in there. $(danger)Die$() and you wake up back home.
